description: This Java class 'HL7InQueueProcessor' is responsible for processing messages in the HL7 inbound queue within the OpenMRS healthcare software. It handles processing individual queue entries, processing the next available queue item, and processing the entire queue in a separate thread, while managing concurrency and memory cleanup.

classes.name: HL7InQueueProcessor
classes.description: A class that processes HL7 message entries from the inbound queue, handling processing, concurrency, and memory management within the OpenMRS healthcare platform.

methods.description: Retrieves and processes the next HL7 queue entry if available.

methods.name: processHL7InQueue
methods.description: Starts a thread to process all existing HL7InQueue entries, preventing multiple concurrent executions.
